question: Find the account ID of the client who resides in North Bohemia, opened their account in 1993, has a loan with duration over 12 months, and also holds a junior credit card issued after 1996. Among these accounts, return the one with the highest loan amount that has made at least one cash withdrawal ('VYBER').

arguments.sql:
SELECT a."XCL_001"
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN district AS dist ON a."XCL_002" = dist."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a."XCL_001" = d."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d."XCL_014" = c."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN card AS cd ON d."XCL_013" = cd."XCL_006"
WHERE dist."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a."XCL_004") = '1993'
  AND l."XCL_037" > 12
  AND cd."XCL_007" = 'junior'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', cd."XCL_008") > '1996'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t."XCL_047" = a."XCL_001"
      AND t."XCL_050" = 'VYBER'
  )
ORDER BY l."XCL_036" DESC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT a."XCL_001"
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN district AS dist ON a."XCL_002" = dist."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a."XCL_001" = d."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d."XCL_014" = c."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN card AS cd ON d."XCL_013" = cd."XCL_006"
WHERE dist."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a."XCL_004") = '1993'
  AND l."XCL_037" > 12
  AND cd."XCL_007" = 'junior'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', cd."XCL_008") > '1996'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t."XCL_047" = a."XCL_001"
      AND t."XCL_050" = 'VYBER'
  )
ORDER BY l."XCL_036" DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN district AS dist ON a."XCL_002" = dist."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a."XCL_001" = d."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d."XCL_014" = c."XCL_009"

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT a."XCL_001"
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a."XCL_001" = d."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d."XCL_013" = c."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN district AS dist ON c."XCL_012" = dist."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN card AS card ON d."XCL_013" = card."XCL_006"
INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
WHERE dist."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a."XCL_004") = '1993'
  AND l."XCL_037" > 12
  AND card."XCL_007" = 'junior'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', card."XCL_008") > '1996'
  AND t."XCL_049" = 'VYBER'
ORDER BY l."XCL_036" DESC
LIMIT 1
